AnimationPromiseUtils.luau.description: Animation Promise Utils provides the class/model implementation used by the Animationutils package. Public entry points include `AnimationPromiseUtils.promiseFinished`, `AnimationPromiseUtils.promiseLoaded`, `AnimationPromiseUtils.promiseKeyframeReached`.

AnimationTrackUtils.luau.description: Utility functions for animations Public entry points include `AnimationTrackUtils.loadAnimationFromId`, `AnimationTrackUtils.setWeightTargetIfNotSet`.

AnimationUtils.luau.description: Utility functions for animations with reactive programming support Public entry points include `AnimationUtils.loadAnimationFromId`, `AnimationUtils.setWeightTargetIfNotSet`, `AnimationUtils.getOrCreateAnimator`, `AnimationUtils.getOrCreateAnimationTrack`, `AnimationUtils.getOrCreateAnimationFromIdInAnimator`, `AnimationUtils.stopAnimations`, `AnimationUtils.stopAnimation`, `AnimationUtils.isPlayingAnimationTrack`.
